name: Blade of Four Energies (Greater)
text:
This +3 greater striking shifting shortsword is formed of rapidly vibrating air and magical energy, though it uses the same statistics as iron. The wooden hilt is adorned with four gems, representing the energies of acid, cold, fire, and electricity, that sparkle in sequence at random intervals.

---
Activate—Cycle Energy f (manipulate)

Frequency once per round

---
Effect You draw magical energy from one of the gems. Roll 1d4. Until the start of your next turn, the weapon gains the effects of the corresponding property rune:
- Greater Corrosive,

- Greater Flaming,

- Greater Frost, or

- Greater Shock.

Effect: Blade of Four Energies

---
Activate—Release Energy 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Requirements The blade has an energy rune from Cycle Energy

---
Effect You call upon the energy stored in the blade to explode outward. You cast a 7th-rank spell that depends on the active rune:
- Acid Grip for corrosive

- Fireball for flaming,

- 2-action Howling Blizzard for frost, or

- Lightning Bolt for shock.

The DC for these spells is 38.
